categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen EXC-LED Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in outdoor intelligent lighting and cloud control systems, including LED landscape lighting, smart road lighting, and intelligent control systems. The company has expanded into the new energy sector, focusing on electric vehicle charging piles and new energy battery safety materials. It also engages in photovoltaic and wind power product sales and installation services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced LED point light source technology, intelligent lighting cloud control platforms (ECCP 5.0), RDM remote device management systems, and zero-carbon lighting control systems integrating photovoltaic energy storage. It employs modular and customized design for smart street lamps and develops core components for electric vehicle charging piles with in-house R&D. Production follows project-based order manufacturing with digital traceability and a mix of order-driven and safety stock strategies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government municipal projects, cultural tourism sites, commercial complexes, high-end hotels, and automotive manufacturers. The company serves large-scale urban lighting projects, smart city infrastructure, and new energy vehicle charging networks. Major clients also encompass listed companies and industry-leading enterprises in lighting and new energy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant sales in East China, South China, Central China, Southwest China, North China, Northwest China, and Northeast China regions. It also has overseas sales primarily through direct sales channels, with subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and other international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: EXC-LED operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the LED lighting and new energy supply chains. It manufactures LED lighting products and intelligent control systems, integrates smart city infrastructure solutions, and produces key components for electric vehicle charging piles and battery safety materials. The company also provides system integration and after-sales services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes technology-driven innovation with significant R&D investment focused on LED lighting, smart control platforms, and new energy vehicle charging technologies. Strategic priorities include vertical integration in the new energy sector, development of high-voltage fast charging, thermal management systems, and smart lighting solutions aligned with China's dual carbon goals. It pursues strategic acquisitions to enhance capabilities in electric motor components and battery materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of LED lighting products, smart control systems, new energy electronic auxiliary materials, photovoltaic and wind power products, and electric vehicle charging piles. The company also earns income from system integration services, project-based contracts, and after-sales support. Domestic sales dominate, primarily via direct sales, supplemented by distribution channels; overseas sales are conducted through direct sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the landscape lighting segment, competitors include unlisted companies like Hangzhou Rolight, Foshan Galaxy, and Suzhou Grand Canyon. In smart city lighting, competitors include listed companies such as Unilumin Technology, Huati Technology, and Kingsun Optoelectronic. In the new energy charging pile sector, competitors include industrial power equipment firms, charging station operators like Teld, and power grid companies such as State Grid. EXC-LED positions itself as a leading national high-tech enterprise with strong R&D and project execution capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 903 million, a 15.37% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 107 million. The LED lighting business revenue declined by 27.13%, while new energy materials and photovoltaic sectors showed growth. The company maintains total assets of around RMB 2.5 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of about RMB 1.49 billion. Despite recent losses, cash flow from operations improved significantly.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EXC-LED emphasizes its technological leadership in LED point light sources, intelligent cloud control platforms, and integrated smart lighting solutions. It offers high-efficiency, low-glare lighting products with advanced optical design and proprietary RDM chips. The company’s zero-carbon lighting systems and integrated photovoltaic energy solutions align with environmental sustainability goals. Its comprehensive one-stop service from design to system integration and strong project delivery capability differentiate it in the market.
